code: chi2_vs <- function(counts, reference) {   expected <- rowSums(counts) * prop.table(reference, 1)   expected[is.na(expected)] <- 0   sum((counts - expected)^2 / ifelse(expected == 0, 1, expected)) }  pooled <- Reduce(`+`, lag_counts) per_lag <- vapply(lag_counts, chi2_vs, numeric(1), reference = pooled) per_lag ##       Q1       Q2       Q3       Q4       Q5  ## 40.55985 55.47520 17.75290 40.03910 46.79668 giddy_per_lag <- c(   40.5598541260764, 55.4751973848766, 17.7528996233674,   40.0390961477108, 46.7966803487369 ) all.equal(unname(per_lag), giddy_per_lag) ## [1] TRUE all.equal(sum(per_lag), homogeneity_test(spatial)$statistic[1]) ## [1] TRUE var_first_passage <- function(P) {   k <- nrow(P)   stat <- steady_state(P)   Z <- solve(diag(k) - P + matrix(stat, k, k, byrow = TRUE))   M <- first_passage(P)   ZM <- Z %*% M   W <- M %*% (2 * diag(diag(Z)) %*% diag(1 / stat) - diag(k)) +     2 * (ZM - matrix(1, k, k) %*% diag(diag(ZM)))   W - M * M }  P <- matrix(c(0.5, 0.25, 0.25, 0.5, 0, 0.5, 0.25, 0.25, 0.5), 3, byrow = TRUE) var_first_passage(P) ##          [,1] [,2]     [,3] ## [1,] 5.583333   12 6.888889 ## [2,] 6.222222   12 6.222222 ## [3,] 6.888889   12 5.583333 1 - diag(transition_matrix(income_chain)) ##         Q1         Q2         Q3         Q4         Q5  ## 0.08538163 0.17345598 0.20572917 0.15143603 0.06217617 P <- matrix(c(0.5, 0.5, 0, NA, NA, NA, 0, 0.2, 0.8), 3, byrow = TRUE) P[is.na(P)] <- 0 diag(P)[rowSums(P) == 0] <- 1 P ##      [,1] [,2] [,3] ## [1,]  0.5  0.5  0.0 ## [2,]  0.0  1.0  0.0 ## [3,]  0.0  0.2  0.8 X <- matrix(c(0, 1, 2, 3, 1, 0, 1, 2, 2, 1, 0, 1, 4, 2, 1, 0), 4, byrow = TRUE) t(X)[upper.tri(X)] ## [1] 1 2 1 4 2 1

title: Markov Mobility Indices — mobility_index
text: x grd_markov object square transition probability matrix. measure Character vector indices compute. : "prais": Prais–Shorrocks trace index, (k - trace(P)) / (k - 1). "determinant": 1 - |det(P)|. "eigen": Sommers–Conlisk index, one minus modulus second-largest eigenvalue P. "bartholomew1": (k - k * sum(initial * diag(P))) / (k - 1). "bartholomew2": expected number class boundaries crossed one transition, sum(initial[] * P[, j] * |- j|) / (k - 1). Class distance uses class ordering, classes assumed ordinal. initial Optional initial distribution classes used Bartholomew indices. Defaults uniform distribution, matching giddy.
